item.title: Risk assessment for LLMs and AI agents: OWASP, MITRE Atlas, and NIST AI RMF explained
item.description:
Author: Maxime Beauchemin
Date: N/A
Tags: ["AI Security", "Risk Management", "Cybersecurity Frameworks", "Artificial Intelligence", "Technology Governance"]
Summary:
  • LLMs and AI agents pose new security and risk challenges.
  • OWASP lists common AI vulnerabilities.
  • MITRE ATLAS catalogs adversarial AI attack methods.
  • NIST AI RMF guides AI risk governance and accountability.
  • Combining these frameworks improves risk assessment.
  • Organizations can better secure AI systems using these tools.

item.title: Agentic Tool Extraction: A Multi-Turn Attack that Exposes the Agent’s Internal Functions
item.description:
Author: Alexandre Lebrun
Date: N/A
Tags: ["Artificial Intelligence", "Cybersecurity", "AI Vulnerabilities", "Adversarial Attacks", "Agentic Systems"]
Summary:
  • Agentic AI systems use internal tools to perform tasks autonomously.
  • A multi-turn attack called Agentic Tool Extraction reveals these internal functions.
  • The attack extracts sensitive tool information through iterative dialogue.
  • This vulnerability poses security risks and potential misuse.
  • The article discusses defenses to protect agentic systems.
  • It stresses balancing transparency with security in AI design.
